[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant emphasized the importance of staying organized, flexible, and open to feedback throughout the planning process.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended starting with a 5K for a first-time charity run organizer due to simpler logistics, broader appeal, lower costs, and easier execution.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided pros and cons for 5K, 10K, and full marathon distances, highlighting the accessibility of a 5K for beginners and casual runners.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned safety considerations, including risk management, emergency response plans, first aid availability, and participant communication.
